entries.title: Psalms 6:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On stringed instruments, upon Sheminith. A Psalm of David.>> Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, and chasten me not in thy hot displeasure.

entries.title: Psalms 6:2
segments: Be gracious unto me, Jehovah, for I am withered; Jehovah, heal me, for my bones tremble.

entries.title: Psalms 6:3
segments: And my soul trembleth exceedingly: and thou, Jehovah, till how long?

entries.title: Psalms 6:4
segments: Return, Jehovah, free my soul; save me for thy loving-kindness' sake.

entries.title: Psalms 6:5
segments: For in death there is no remembrance of thee; in Sheol who shall give thanks unto thee?

entries.title: Psalms 6:6
segments: I am wearied with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I dissolve my couch with my tears.

entries.title: Psalms 6:7
segments: Mine eye wasteth away through grief; it hath grown old because of all mine oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 6:8
segments: ¶Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

entries.title: Psalms 6:9
segments: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah receiveth my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 6:10
segments: All mine enemies shall be ashamed and tremble exceedingly; they will turn, they will be ashamed suddenly.
